name: Reno3 Pro

Network.Technology: Reno3 Pro, GSM / HSPA / LTE, Reno3 Pro 5G, GSM / CDMA / HSPA / EVDO / LTE / 5G

Cameras.Front camera: Dual-front, Reno3 Pro: 44 MP, 26mm (wide), 1/2.65", 2MP, () depth sensor, Single-front, Reno3 Pro 5G: 32 MP, 26mm (wide), 1/2.8", Both models support HDR, with 1080p @ 30fps video recording

Battery.Charging: Reno3: Fast charging up to 30W, USB Type-C 2.0, Fast charging up to 30W, USB Type-C 3.1
